verdict.rationale: Cactus documents an experimental path to convert any HuggingFace model, an engine with OpenAI-compatible APIs for text, speech and vision, and a Needle model that returns sentence vectors. That covers LLM, multimodal and embedding use in a basic way. Breadth is unproven: there is no list of supported architectures and nothing on MoE, and one user reports the app crashing on selecting downloaded GGUF models (Jan Nano, SmolLM3). Missing for 10: evidence of hundreds of supported architectures, any MoE support, non-experimental general conversion, and independent confirmation that diverse architectures run reliably.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run hundreds of different model architectures including LLMs, MoE, multi-modal, and embedding models

citations.quote: Any HuggingFace model can be converted using cactus convert [HF-Name], though experimental.
